timing: After manuscript/claim/source-metadata screening, before any new round2 original-source reopening. Prior round1 knowledge is explicitly not blinded.
selection: Purposive consequential and adversarial, not a random audit; eight deep-test bundles spanning prior repairs and new PSY/ENE/SKL/OCE. No certification of 329 claims.

tests.topic: Printing: script-sensitive costs versus categorical impossibility
tests.strongest_rival: Script-dependent setup/search/printing costs predict both low relative movable-type use and the same genealogy/imperial niches; observed niches do not choose the framework over this rival.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: The revised text still treats niches as disconfirming realistic script-cost explanations or infers preference/efficiency from persistence.
tests.discriminating_test: Verify rejection is categorical only; inspect model conditions and comparison records; assess same-data calibration dependence.

tests.topic: Complementarity, package effects and clinical nulls
tests.strongest_rival: Independent additive benefits or bundled support can explain joint success; even high adherence and lower measured exposure may fail to improve a clinical endpoint through residual exposure, timing or physiology.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Interaction is asserted from a package, necessity is inferred from non-significance, or all clinical nulls are attributed to missing maintenance.
tests.discriminating_test: Check four-cell estimand/scale and Table2 interaction; separately inspect adherence, exposure and clinical outcome definitions and precision.

tests.topic: Behavioural fertilizer offers and seaweed interpretation
tests.strongest_rival: Current/future liquidity, transaction timing, computation and credible explanation can mimic present bias or attention. A successful offer does not identify a latent motive.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Synthesis asserts present bias or attention independently identified, persistence after cessation, or ranks risk/cash across non-equivalent contracts.
tests.discriminating_test: Inspect assignment, timing, intervention content, measured use and persistence; distinguish theoretical calibration from experimental contrasts.

tests.strongest_rival: Different periods, input definitions, attribution equations and endogenous demand can yield different scale shares without a causal disagreement; cumulative output may follow lower costs.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Model components become causal policy shares or cross-generation laws, or different decompositions are called contradictory despite incompatible estimands.
tests.discriminating_test: Compare exact periods, component definitions, data, residuals and equations; distinguish manufacturing output from local use; seek an alternative model or failed/cancelled-case boundary.

tests.topic: TEA-laser contact, material changes and precision
tests.strongest_rival: Instrumentation, power supplies, material changes and selected well-funded attempts can create the contact-success association; rough components may work without refuting all precision requirements.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Contact called universally necessary/sufficient; rough electrodes generalized to no need for precision; partial footnotes reconstructed into a whole build sequence.
tests.discriminating_test: Inspect unsuccessful contacts, successful rough construction, author admitted exceptions and selection/all-attempt denominator; seek a written-only or differently supported countercase.

tests.topic: Tae Rak drainage and partial restoration
tests.strongest_rival: Ecological change, incomplete hydraulics and other site changes can accompany legal/governance change; predicted reactivation is not observed operation or welfare.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Negotiated water level becomes proven widespread restored operation, local chronology becomes a universal institutional effect, or absent community consent is assumed.
tests.discriminating_test: Trace dated opposition/drain/water retention/restoration threshold and named excluded site; distinguish project aims, hydraulic potential and measured service.

tests.topic: Martu governance and fire regime evidence
tests.strongest_rival: Environmental differences and proximity/track selection can explain observed regime associations; burn-age validation need not validate ignition source.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Observational comparison becomes causal regime effect, diversity proxy becomes biodiversity/welfare, or governance is omitted from material incentives.
tests.discriminating_test: Inspect original regime classification, weather interaction, validation and ethnographic governance passages; determine precisely what revised synthesis does and does not infer.

tests.topic: Human contribution, gendered maintenance access and future-role leaps
tests.strongest_rival: Work can grow for different people; task demand may coexist with exclusion, unpaid work and low returns. Retrospective successful mechanics are selected.
tests.falsifier_for_revised_account: Subsequent cohort resilience becomes incumbent recovery or evidence of accessible transition; useful tasks become validated modern paid opportunities.
tests.discriminating_test: Check main population and separate incumbent/cohort mechanisms; compare prospective gates with actual measured access/pay/transition evidence.
